description: This file contains serialization-related classes and codecs for ReadOnlyDictionary, including a serializer, surrogate, and deep copier implementations.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A serializer codec for ReadOnlyDictionary, converting it to and from a surrogate.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A surrogate struct for serializing ReadOnlyDictionary via its underlying Dictionary.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A deep copier for ReadOnlyDictionary, allowing deep cloning of the collection.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a ReadOnlyDictionary instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlyDictionary into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of a ReadOnlyDictionary, handling cyclic references and using key/value copiers.
